label: Java SDK 3.3.0
type: first entry in the Java SDK's own independent version family - kept separate from version:server-*, version:cbl-*, and version:sgw-* per the same product-independence pattern used for those
note: Promoted at first sighting following the precedent set by version:cbl-3.3.0 (round 3, also recurrence-1-at-promotion) - version/edition enums are treated as low-cardinality, high-value closed vocabularies promoted on sight rather than held to the usual 2-file recurrence bar, same reasoning as the original edition:enterprise/community pre-minting.
